replay_check_scope: Displayed-value arithmetic only: 3 balance-sheet identities, 3 cash-flow sums and 3 rounded gross margins. Passing these checks is not independent source verification, an audit, or a claim that provider-normalized metrics equal GAAP metrics.
metric_comparison_guards: EBITDA, Net Income and EPS carry Analyst Normalized labels. They are not relabeled GAAP and are not treated as exact matches to unadjusted or Orbis net income.
Cash Flow from Operations (Indirect) is the explicitly captured PitchBook category. The undefined Orbis Cash Flow label is not assumed to mean CFO.
Total Debt definitions and the exact consolidated perimeter are not available in this capture.
Raw Revenue % Growth values are retained. The 2024 and TTM growth denominators are not supplied; they are not reconstructed from unrelated periods.
Post-2024 columns remain a later supplement to the FY2024 historical case.
